mechanism: Echinacea may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, potentially increasing modafinil plasma concentrations, while modafinil induces CYP3A4, which may reduce echinacea's efficacy.
action: Monitor for increased modafinil side effects (insomnia, headache, tachycardia); no dose adjustment typically required but counsel patient on concurrent use.
